The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twentieth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[S20|Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]], in {{pmin|the United States}} and {{pmin|Canada}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 1}}). ==The Complete Collection== [[File:Pokémon the Series Sun and Moon Region 1 The Complete Collection.png|thumb|200px|Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon - The Complete Collection]] Pokémon the Series: Sun and Moon - The Complete Collection was released on November 6, 2018 by [[VIZ Media]] and distributed through {{wp|Warner Home Video}}. This [[Complete Collection]] contains six discs with 43 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000079935. Optional English closed captioning is included. Clean versions of the [[Under The Alolan Sun|opening and ending themes]] are included as a special feature. {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Alola}}; border: 2px solid #{{colorschemedark|Alola}}" !
